facts.fact: Neela knows the lower narrows and the shelf only by sight from the east terraces and by hearsay of its going; she has not crossed it before this night.

Neela drops the satchel on the patrol path deliberately: Asha's note asked for a second token, so Devan gets it, and a bag on the path makes the camp read as raiders rather than a cat-kill. She knows it tells Devan someone stood there before him.
